title: What If the Isthmus of Panama Never Formed?

scenes.text: What if Panama never rose from the sea? The two Americas would still be islands.
Studies date the land bridge to about 2.8 million years ago.
Before that, Pacific and Caribbean surface waters kept mixing, as deep-sea sediments show.
Without the barrier, land animals wouldn't have begun crossing between the continents about 2.7 million years ago.
Climate models say closing the seaway strengthened Atlantic circulation and added snow over Greenland and North America.
But the effect on ice sheets was small, about five centimeters of sea level. Panama reshaped life more than ice.

description:
What if Panama never connected the Americas?
The land bridge formed about 2.8 million years ago, and it changed ocean currents and animal migrations.
What should we run through next?
